title: Addition and Subtraction of Large Numbers
seo_title: Addition and Subtraction – Primary 5 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add and subtract whole numbers with up to seven digits, with and without exchanging; check answers by the inverse operation; solve word problems. (summary of the NERDC Primary 5 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 5 maths worksheets on adding and subtracting large whole numbers in columns, mental strategies, checking answers and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Check: answer + number taken away = first number.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers in columns so that units are under units, tens under tens and so on.
  • Add or subtract from the right. Exchange 10 of one place for 1 of the next place when you need to.
  • Check a subtraction by adding: 7,415 − 2,638 = 4,777 because 4,777 + 2,638 = 7,415.

Examples

Example

45,286 + 37,915

6 + 5 = 11, write 1 carry 1

… work left

Answer: 83,201

Example

60,004 − 2,385

Exchange across the zeros

Answer: 57,619

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not lining up the unitsWrite the numbers from the right.
Taking the smaller digit from the bigger oneIn 52 − 38 you must exchange: 12 − 8, not 8 − 2.
Forgetting a carried 1Write the carried 1 small above the next column.

faq.q: What is the inverse of addition?
faq.a: Subtraction. Use it to check your answer.

items.q: Hadiza worked out 72,315 − 38,742 = 43,573. Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate. Is her answer sensible?
items.e: Estimate: 72,000 − 39,000 = 33,000. Hadiza's answer, 43,573, is about 10,000 bigger than the estimate. She exchanged 1 ten thousand for 10 thousands but did not change the 7 to 6. The correct answer is 33,573.

items.q: Ashford has 74,385 people. Brookfield has 18,640 more people than Ashford. How many people live in the two towns altogether?
items.e: Step 1, people in Brookfield: 74,385 + 18,640 = 93,025. Step 2, both together: 74,385 + 93,025 = 167,410.

items.e: Step 1, 2,023 and 2,024: 12,486 km + 14,075 km = 26,561 km. Step 2, find the difference: 26,561 km − 11,938 km = 14,623 km.

A website had 286,450 visitors in January and 315,780 visitors in February. Another website had 650,000 visitors in the same two months. How many more visitors did the other website have?
items.e: Step 1, visitors to the first website: 286,450 + 315,780 = 602,230. Step 2, find the difference: 650,000 − 602,230 = 47,770.

items.q: Kelechi’s dad is a lorry driver. This year he plans to drive 100,000 km. He drove 45,120 km from January to June and 37,465 km from July to October. How many kilometres are left to drive this year?
items.e: Step 1, kilometres driven: 45,120 km + 37,465 km = 82,585 km. Step 2, kilometres left: 100,000 km − 82,585 km = 17,415 km. Check: 17,415 km + 82,585 km = 100,000 km.

items.q: On Saturday, 34,568 fans watched a match at one stadium and 28,795 fans watched a match at another. On Sunday, 72,000 fans watched the cup final. How many more fans watched the cup final than the two Saturday matches?
items.e: Step 1, fans on Saturday: 34,568 + 28,795 = 63,363. Step 2, find the difference: 72,000 − 63,363 = 8,637.

items.q: A city library had 64,005 books. It gave away 8,368 old books and then bought 5,275 new books. How many books does it have now?
items.e: Step 1, after giving away: 64,005 − 8,368 = 55,637. Step 2, after buying: 55,637 + 5,275 = 60,912.

items.q: A delivery company’s vans must drive 250,000 km this year. They drove 98,476 km in the first four months and 87,950 km in the next four months. How many kilometres are left?
items.e: Step 1, kilometres driven: 98,476 km + 87,950 km = 186,426 km. Step 2, kilometres left: 250,000 km − 186,426 km = 63,574 km. Check: 63,574 km + 186,426 km = 250,000 km.

items.q: A warehouse had 125,400 parcels. It sent out 87,965 parcels, then a lorry delivered 46,580 more. How many parcels are in the warehouse now?
items.e: Step 1, after sending: 125,400 − 87,965 = 37,435. Step 2, after the delivery: 37,435 + 46,580 = 84,015.
